# AI Test Workbench (`ai-test-workbench` / `aitw` v6.1.0)

> Trustworthy Verification Kernel & AI-Agent-First native multi-protocol MCP Server (`stdio`, Streamable HTTP `/mcp`, Legacy HTTP+SSE `/sse`) for Playwright E2E/API verification. Supports Chinese-default docs with paired English `.en.md` docs.

## Core v6.1.0 Capabilities
- **Authoritative 4-Layer Anti-Fake-Green Gate Kernel (`src/kernel/gate-kernel.mjs`, `src/kernel/gate/rules/`, `src/governance.mjs`, `src/ledger.mjs`)**: Pluggable `AITEST-G101..G115` AST rules with lexical scope stack and cross-file title pooling, T1 MAC `.aitest/governance.lock`, `tsc` + `eslint-plugin-playwright`, and ULID `Run Ledger` input-hash binding (`FGER-internal = 0.0% (26/26)`, `FGER-holdout = 0.0% (24/24)`, real-world unseen holdout FPR `6.1% [2.1%, 16.5%]`).
- **Native Multi-Protocol MCP Server & Job Runner (`src/mcp/`, `src/jobs.mjs`)**: Zero runtime npm dependencies; supports MCP `2024-11-05`..`2025-11-25` with **17 canonical typed tools** (`aitest_heal` and `aitest_job` action-dispatched, with 6 v5 deprecated aliases retained in v6.x), isolated child-process jobs (`syncBudgetMs`), `_meta.progressToken` heartbeats, `notifications/cancelled` process-tree termination, concurrent read tools, and per-workspace write locks.
- **One-Call Change Verdict & Stateful Healer (`src/verdict.mjs`, `src/heal.mjs`, `src/traceability.mjs`)**: `aitest_verify_change` emits `attestation.json` (in-toto v1 + T0/T1/T2), `verdict-summary.md`, and `verdict.sarif.json`; `aitest_heal(action="begin"|"attempt"|"conclude")` hard-blocks Class B/C/D test edits (`0.0%` mis-heal rate) and maps `REQ-xxx` traceability.
- **Import-Graph Impact, Living Code Map & Default-Deny Explorer (`src/impact.mjs`, `src/codemap.mjs`, `src/explore.mjs`)**: Static reverse `import` dependency graph with `why` provenance, default-deny read-only exploration (`specs/pages/*.md`), preserved `:id`/`[id]` dynamic routes, and automatic defect convergence.
- **Template Manifest & Hash-Safe Upgrade (`src/upgrade.mjs`, `src/core/config.mjs`)**: One-way vendor mirror (`templates/playwright-qa/support/`) stamped with SHA-256 digests, `aitw upgrade` 3-way safe upgrades, and schema-validated centralized configuration.
- **PerformanceObserver Web Vitals, WCAG 2.0/2.1/2.2 & JSON Schema Contracts (`src/perf.mjs`, `base.ts`, `src/kernel/schema-validator.mjs`)**: Real `LCP / CLS / INP` median & P75 capture, guarded `page.request` + `context.request` + allowlist egress, active W3C `traceparent` correlation, and `100%` seeded-defect detection (`7/7`).
